8.4.2 SecOC_TpRxIndication
[SWS_SecOC_00125]⌈
Service Name
SecOC_TpRxIndication
Syntax
void SecOC_TpRxIndication (
PduIdType id,
Std_ReturnType result
)
Service ID
[hex]
0x45
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Reentrant
Parameters (in)
id
Identification of the received I-PDU.
result
E_OK: The PDU was received. E_NOT_OK: Reception of the PDU
failed.
Parameters
None
(inout)
Parameters
(out)
None
Return value
None
Description
Called after an I-PDU has been received via the TP API, the result indicates
whether the transmission was successful or not.
Available via
SecOC.h
